Subject: Reminder - Professorial Lecture by Ben Jacobsen 1st May

Just one final reminder of the next Professorial lecture which is being
held this Thursday the 1st May 2008 when Professor Ben Jacobsen will
present his topic: "Financial Analysts: what are they good for?" It is
still not too late to RSVP if you haven't already done so.

Abstract:
Where is the market going? Will the Kiwi go up or down? The media report
financial analyst forecasts on an almost daily basis. Should we take
those predictions seriously or might you as well flip a coin? Are
financial markets predictable and if so how? I will discuss some
surprising and practical insights academic research has to offer.

Staff, students and members of the public are welcome to this lecture.

Time:
7.00 Wine and Hors d'oeuvres
7.30pm Professorial Lecture

Where:
Sir Neil Waters Lecture Theatres Building, NW200.
Gate 1, Albany Expressway

RSVP - by 28th April for catering purposes to
u.dgfphz@massey.ac.nz

Please note this lecture is free of charge.
A reasonable standard of dress is required.

Website:
http://auckland.massey.ac.nz

Future lectures in the Professorial Lecture Series are:

29 May - Professor Michael Townsend
"Research in education: science or common sense?"

If you have any queries regarding the Professorial Lecture Series,
please do not hesitate to contact me.

Kind regards
Karen Triggs
Massey University Auckland
Events Management
Phone: 09 414 0800 Ext 9555
http://auckland.massey.ac.nz
